review_notes: I read the whole file. I did not open the Mathlib sources or the project's Definitions modules, so this judgement rests on the file's own text. The new data-level declarations are SumSigma, TeleSigma, toSum, sumEnds and F0. SumSigma and TeleSigma are abbreviations for dependent sigma types of places. toSum and sumEnds are specific index maps tied to the SemistableCovering structure. F0 is an abbreviation for the project's xHFunctionField at a specific level. None of these represents a concept Mathlib already has in a competing form. The remaining declarations are theorems, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. natCast_mem_P just wraps the root-level natCast_mem. isRational_of_isCurveOver is a lemma about the project's own Place.IsRational and IsCurveOver. The large `solution` theorem is a conjunction of facts, not a competing definition. I found no justified finding. The only residual uncertainty is that I did not check whether the project's Place or IsRational definitions in the imported modules overlap with Mathlib. Those definitions are outside the target file.
